acceptance_criteria: Test infrastructure compiles. Session helper returns correct primary account.
close_reason: Created tests/common/mod.rs (build_session, make_client), tests/helpers_smoke.rs, fixture JSONs; 23 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create the scaffold for wiremock integration tests: fixture JSON files and a shared session/client helper module.

**Algorithm:**
1. Create tests/fixtures/sharing/session.json — a JMAP Session with urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals in capabilities and primaryAccounts["urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals"] = "u33084183". The apiUrl field is a placeholder to be replaced at test runtime.
2. Create tests/fixtures/sharing/principal_get_response.json — a complete Principal/get response from RFC 9670 §4.1 Figure 3 (Joe Bloggs Principal). Wrapped in methodResponses envelope with call-id "r1".
3. Create tests/fixtures/sharing/share_notification_get_response.json — a complete ShareNotification/get response with one notification (hand-written from RFC 9670 §3 field descriptions). Wrapped in methodResponses envelope.
4. Create tests/common/mod.rs with:
   - fn build_session(api_url: &str) -> jmap_base_client::Session: constructs Session JSON with the given apiUrl injected, parses to Session struct.
   - fn jmap_client() -> jmap_base_client::JmapClient: builds client with NoneAuth.
   Oracle for session JSON shape: RFC 8620 §2.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- cargo test -p jmap-sharing-client compiles including the new test infrastructure.
- build_session(url).primary_account_id("urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals") == Some("u33084183").
- session.json, principal_get_response.json, share_notification_get_response.json all valid JSON.
title: Add wiremock test infrastructure: fixtures and session helper
